subject.title: Control UI: Model provider display shows original config value instead of normalized value (e.g., 'bailian' vs 'zai')

question: Should Control UI provider displays and Usage aggregates show only canonical provider IDs, or preserve configured aliases with canonical context, for supported aliases such as z-ai/z.ai and any proposed bailian mapping?
rationale: The source fix shape is clear, but the decision affects user-visible provider identity, CSV/export contents, and aggregate grouping semantics, and the bailian alias is not currently a documented contract.

options.title: Canonicalize derived UI/API values
options.body: Normalize derived display, filter, suggestion, CSV, and aggregate keys for supported aliases while leaving raw config/session storage unchanged.

options.title: Show alias plus canonical context
options.body: Display values such as `zai (alias: z-ai)` where raw configured identity matters, at the cost of wider UI copy and tests.

options.title: Preserve raw provider values
options.body: Keep the current behavior and document that Control UI Usage reflects stored provider strings even when internal routing canonicalizes them.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize derived UI/API values
recommendation.body: Normalize derived display, filter, suggestion, CSV, and aggregate keys for supported aliases while leaving raw config/session storage unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available owner signal from recent Usage module and provider-usage work plus the broader product/API contract question.
